Roles: source of the echoed phrase 'originally not a single thing'

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Master Tianyin (天隱和尚語錄), chamber encounter. Yinqian (印乾) is the exact named speaker who, after an awakening, enters the room and presents the verse beginning 'before father and mother were born, originally not a single thing'; Tianyin Yuanxiu questions him and later responds with a shout and verse. Huineng is echoed by the second clause but is not the speaker here.
